title: CLEAR STASH GUN MENU SELECTION
why: The break down follow-up review found no source selection on keys, a tenth key labelled 10 instead of 0, a repeated backpack heading and empty stash space. Keep menu selection distinct from rarity and make the existing labels agree. Watch: cheap parts could make bench guns and armour easy to craft; watch his stash for servo and board hoards.
now: The stash gun menu marks its source with a separate 2px lime ring until closing. Its last key reads 0 and still binds slot nine. Empty spaces have faint noninteractive outlines with no inventory limit. The repeated backpack heading is removed, section shortcuts are separated from filters, and cash has a matching label beside stash and bag values.
